children: Goobit launched Futureproof, a savings platform combining Bitcoin, gold and interest-bearing assets, using Kvarn Capital for MiCA-regulated crypto execution, custody and transfers. Beta is planned for Oct 2026 with commercial launch targeted for Q4 2026.

AI Analyst View
Launch of Futureproof platform
Shifts Goobit from transaction-only trading to recurring savings, potentially diversifying revenue.
Partnership with Kvarn Capital
Enables regulated crypto execution/custody via an EEA-passported CASP, reducing regulatory risk.
Beta planned Oct 2026
Sets a near-term milestone; delays would weaken the thesis.
Q4 2026 commercial launch target
Introduces potential revenue ramp timing if adoption occurs.
Own MiCA bid under appeal
Regulatory path remains uncertain; partnership mitigates dependency near term.
Offer to 250K+ BTCX accounts
Built-in distribution could accelerate early user acquisition.

This is an early-stage strategy pivot expanding beyond bitcoin trading into savings with multi-asset exposure. For a larger catalyst, watch beta-to-launch execution, user uptake from BTCX base, and clarity on Goobit’s MiCA authorisation outcome.
